draft:
Dear valued investors,

We are writing to inform you of a new investment in Pinterest (the "Company"), a visual discovery and bookmarking platform that lets users organize images they find interesting onto themed boards. We have committed USD 10 million in the Company's Series A at a pre-money valuation of USD 40 million, for approximately 20% on a fully-diluted basis.

What attracted us was the user engagement profile. Average session length on the Company's platform is approximately 14 minutes, compared to roughly 7 minutes on Facebook and 2-3 minutes on most social bookmarking products. Users return roughly six times per week on average, and 68% remain active 30 days after first signup. The median active user pins around eight items per week. These are exceptional engagement metrics for a consumer product at this stage.

The Company's user base is unusual in two respects. First, 82% of active users are women — an unusually high concentration. Second, the user base skews older than typical social products, with heaviest concentration in the 25-44 age range. This combination — engaged users, female-skewed, older demographic — represents a strong and underserved advertising audience and supports a credible long-term monetization path through native advertising in categories such as home decor, fashion, and weddings.

The founders, Mr. Ben Silbermann and Mr. Evan Sharp, are first-time founders but our diligence has been deeply positive. Mr. Silbermann in particular has built a reputation at Google for being unusually focused on users and product. The Company currently has 8 employees, including the founders, and 1.5 million monthly active users. There is no revenue yet — the founders have deliberately deferred monetization in favour of growing engagement.

The risks are clear. The Company has no monetization strategy yet. The current engagement profile may not survive scaling beyond the early adopter cohort. Defensibility against well-funded competitive responses is uncertain. We have stress-tested for total loss and consider the risk-adjusted return profile acceptable given the conviction we have in the engagement signal and the founder team.

In summary, the Company combines exceptional engagement, a defensible consumer position, and a founder team in which we have high conviction. We commit to providing further updates as our investment matures.
